conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: Hello, are you Xiyuan’s mother? I’m Quan Jing from Huaming Police Station.
Police: May I see Xiyuan?
Respondent: Oh my!
Respondent: I thought it was a delivery and it startled me. Next time if you come over for something, could you not ring the doorbell? You can just knock. The child is sleeping—I’m afraid of waking her up.
Respondent: I was about to cook, but she started dozing off while watching TV, so I coaxed her to sleep.
Respondent: Come in. She’s under the blanket—I’m not sure if you can see her clearly.
Respondent: Yesterday I took Xiyuan out for a long walk. Maybe she got tired. She had just woken up not long ago and is already sleepy again...
Respondent: Children grow very fast. Xiyuan suddenly grew taller too. There isn’t a single piece of clothing at home that fits her, so I took her out to buy some clothes and things. There’s so much to prepare before school starts, and we still need to have the school uniform tailored. I don’t know when this child will wake up to eat...
Respondent: If you want to see Xiyuan, you’ll probably have to wait a while.
Respondent: By the way...
Respondent: What do you need to see Xiyuan for?
